scenarios.sale-25a: Used car sold between two dealers under the margin scheme (second-hand goods), conformance level 2.
scenarios.sale-25a-level1: The same margin-scheme sale at level 1: vehicle rows only, no line object identifier (BT-128).
scenarios.sale-25a-xborder: Margin-scheme sale of a used car to a dealer in another EU member state.
scenarios.credit-25a: Credit note cancelling the margin-scheme sale.
scenarios.export-25a: Margin-scheme export of a used car to a buyer outside the EU (VAT category G).
scenarios.new-intra-eu: New means of transport supplied VAT-exempt to a business buyer in another member state; vehicle already registered, so the date of first entry into service is given.
scenarios.new-intra-eu-unregistered: New means of transport supplied VAT-exempt to a business buyer in another member state; unregistered vehicle.
scenarios.workshop: Workshop invoice: a zero-value vehicle reference line with the rows, labour and parts lines linked to the vehicle by BT-128, and the VIN in BT-18.
scenarios.level0: Conformance level 0: the vehicle is identified by BT-128 only, without any rows.
scenarios.neg-margin-k: Negative control for the checker: margin-scheme flag on an intra-EU exempt line (category K) and further faults. Valid EN 16931, not a valid VINvoice line.
scenarios.neg-profile: Negative control for the checker: malformed rows (statutory key without its label, duplicates, grammar violations).
scenarios.neg-profile2: Negative control for the checker: reader edge cases (unknown major version, unknown key, both odometer units, unmarked rows, a vendor row).
scenarios.sale-regular-odometer-inoperative: Used car sold under normal VAT with an inoperative odometer: the status is stated and no reading is given.
